mathematicalBoundaries.noLiteralInfinityExplanation: Numbers on EVM blockchains are limited by data types (such as uint256, which has a hard ceiling of 2^256 - 1). They cannot represent literal infinity. Checked arithmetic prevents silent overflows.

mathematicalBoundaries.noLiteralInfinityExplanation: Numbers on EVM blockchains are limited by data types (such as uint256, which has a hard ceiling of 2^256 - 1). They cannot represent literal infinity. Checked arithmetic prevents silent overflows.
